title: GENERIO.ai 3D Model Gnerator Optimizer & Re-texture Update
author: Rizzlord
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/ikl8lnmhuu1g1.png?width=2513&format=png&auto=webp&s=6058e6a14b31a7fc250524473969ff66e9f8371d

Hey, we from [GENERIO.ai](https://generio.ai/) rolled out an Optimizer update with more controll of the final Models you create. 

With the new Optimizer, you can easily create Low-Poly assets for Mobile,VR and AR games!

You can also now just describe for a complete retexture!

We provide baked maps like ambient occlusion and normal maps. 

We also have a [Community Discord](https://discord.com/invite/8hwcxmgkv3) and a Market which got new Assets for you to download.

Future Plans are:

1. Ultra Quality models and textures with perfect text rendering.
2. Market will have Buy and sellable models from and for the Community, which you can sell, and we take a small fee for the use of the market system. Also you can sell and buy Whole Asset packs in styles.
3. Unity, Unreal and Godot Plugins for ease of use. (Unreal and Unity already working and will be released soon.
4. Direct model geometry change with marking a part of the model and change the geometry.
5. Model Seperation, for cars etc.
